project.designRead: mobile mini-program UI / pet owners / warm friendly / medium density / avoid cold clinical look
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Warm earth-tone pet app: cream background, terracotta orange accent, rounded cards, pill buttons, AI elements with dashed borders, cozy and friendly

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: warm earth tones: cream #F7F4EF bg, terracotta #C4612F primary, warm neutral text #1F2421
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: PingFang SC / Noto Sans SC sans-serif; 24px title / 20px heading / 15px body / 12px caption
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: rounded cards 16px, pill buttons 9999px, 8px input radius
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceDepthModel: static cards use border+shadow(alpha<=0.05); floating layers use shadow(alpha<=0.10)
styleContinuityAnchors.iconSystem: Lucide SVG icons inline; no emoji as functional icons

mobileNavigation.activeState: primary icon+label color only; geometry stays identical

structure.innerClass: w-full max-w-md mx-auto grid grid-cols-4 h-14
structure.itemClass: min-w-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 px-1 h-full
structure.activeRule: only color/font-weight/data-active may change; no class changes that affect layout

pages.title: 首页（今天）
pages.visualNorthStar: Warm cozy pet dashboard with today's plan at top, quick record buttons prominent, AI discovery card subtle but inviting

pages.title: 成长时间轴
pages.visualNorthStar: Month-grouped timeline with type icons, photo thumbnails, and sticky month headers. Warm and nostalgic feel

pages.title: AI 助手
pages.visualNorthStar: Inviting AI assistant page with dynamic recommended questions as cards, conversation history list, and a prominent input bar at bottom

pages.title: 我的
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean user center with avatar header, pet count stat, and a tidy list of function entries with icons

pages.title: 宠物档案主页
pages.visualNorthStar: Pet digital homepage with large avatar header, 2x2 stats grid, recent activity feed, and AI discovery card

pages.title: 喂食记录
pages.visualNorthStar: Date-grouped feeding record list with quick-feed button at top, time-stamped entries, and AI analysis entry

pages.title: 体重记录与趋势
pages.visualNorthStar: Weight tracking page with SVG line chart, period tabs, summary bar, and record list. Data-focused but warm

pages.title: AI 对话
pages.visualNorthStar: Chat interface with AI messages on left (warm card), user messages on right (primary color), typing indicator, and bottom input bar with camera button
